scientific_integrity: Finite proof gives explicit completeness of two generators and two exact correlation computations; a fourth-moment reformulation is standard and not claimed as new; no independent audit or historical-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact complete enumeration only for binary order-five de Bruijn cycles modulo rotation; periodic, unnormalized two-sided autocorrelation and no claim of all-order, aperiodic, or cross-correlation performance.
title: Exact cyclic integrated sidelobe energy of binary order-five de Bruijn cycles
